title: On di-Cayley graphs and their spectrum
summary: Given a group $G$ and three subsets $S_\ell, S_r, S_m \subset G$, we consider di-Cayley graphs $DX(G;S_\ell,S_r,S_m)$ and di-Cayley sum graphs $DX^+(G;S_\ell,S_r,S_m)$, directed generalizations of the bi-Cayley (sum) graphs $BX(G;S_\ell,S_r,S_m)$ and $BX^+(G;S_\ell,S_r,S_m)$. We refer to these four kinds of graphs collectively as $X^*(G;S_\ell,S_r,S_m)$. First, we give the basic properties of these graphs and compute their adjacency matrices.
